events.title: Air Show
events.description:
Held annually between the Golden Gate Bridge and Alcatraz, the San Francisco Fleet Week Air Show Presented by United Airlines brings world-class aviation to one of the most iconic settings in the world.

At the heart of the Air Show is Marina Green, home to the Marina Green Festival Center. General Admission is free. Unbeatable waterfront hospitality is available through the Air Show Network VIP Experience.

Headlined by the U.S. Navy Blue Angels, the Air Show is also the only show in the United States to feature a commercial airliner, the United 777, performing a fully choreographed aerial demonstration over the Bay.
